title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Senior machine learning engineer and research leader with experience productizing on-device ML, building cloud training pipelines, running A/B studies, and leading interdisciplinary teams in neurotechnology and healthcare.

jobs.summary: Tech Lead on a team productizing AI algorithms for a low-power EMG-based Brain-Computer Interface (Meta Neural Band).
highlights: Implemented on-device inference on 16-bit NPUs with performance parity to floating-point models.
Designed, evaluated, and implemented architecture and training features to optimize accuracy and system performance for three EMG time-course gesture decoder models (CNN, LSTM).
Resolved model NPU incompatibilities by replacing unsupported components with functional equivalents.
Implemented PyTorch training and evaluation pipelines running on multi-GPU cloud infrastructure.
Executed biweekly model release process from branch cut to firmware packaging and helped implement a push-on-green pipeline to fully automate releases.
Designed and executed A/B user studies to measure on-device model performance using power analyses to maximize study efficiency.
Implemented data quality assessment, control, labeling pipelines, and monitoring dashboards.
Refactored multi-sensor fusion feature pipeline to achieve a 10x improvement in temporal alignment.
Implemented numerically accurate, power-optimized preprocessing using DSP techniques.
Led cross-organizational effort to build an automated high-resolution power measurement system with dashboards for monitoring inference pipeline performance.
Led development of tools to estimate PyTorch model performance (power/latency) on various NPU configurations, enabling power- and latency-informed Neural Architecture Search (NAS).

jobs.summary: Tech Lead/Manager supporting a team to optimize job posting placement and improve product recommendation systems.
highlights: Managed and supported six engineers working on Career Guide optimization.
Designed a bag-of-words based clustering system for organizing articles into subgroups to pool statistics and interpolate reader profiles for new articles.

jobs.company: The University of Texas at Austin, Dell Medical School
jobs.summary: Led federally funded research developing AI algorithms to predict diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment outcomes from neuroimaging and multimodal data.
highlights: Managed a grant-supported research agenda applying AI to neuroimaging for neuropsychiatric conditions.
Led development of a mobile app for behavioral and questionnaire data collection to measure environmental impacts on mental health.
Developed fMRI-based brain–computer interfaces for network modulation and neurofeedback research.
Created C-PAC, an open-source neuroimaging pipeline for high-throughput image processing on cloud and HPC systems.
Collaborated to optimize MR imaging protocols for multi-modal brain characterization, pancreas quantification, and whole-body fat quantification.
Built cloud-based neuroimaging AI pipelines for rapid clinical assessment support.
Designed and executed large-scale longitudinal data collection efforts with whole-body imaging and neuropsychiatric assessment.

jobs.company: Nathan S. Kline Institute for Psychiatric Research / Child Mind Institute
jobs.position: Director, Computational Neuroimaging Lab & Director of Imaging
jobs.summary: Managed software engineering and data science teams to develop MRI acquisition, processing, and data-sharing infrastructure for large-scale neuroimaging studies.
highlights: Managed a neuroimaging data collection infrastructure that collected and openly shared hundreds of MRI scans per month (Healthy Brain Network participation).
Optimized MRI sequences for functional, structural, molecular, and abdominal imaging in collaboration with Siemens research scientists.
Monitored image quality and worked with service engineers to resolve issues.
Built PACS for image collection, transfer to long-term storage, and radiological reads.
Directly oversaw operations of a Siemens 1.5T Avanto mobile MRI, including operator training, procedures, and safety protocols.
Established and managed image acquisition on Siemens 3T Tim Trio systems at partner sites.
Coordinated radiological reads and operational workflows.

openScienceProjects.name: C-PAC: The Configurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes
openScienceProjects.description: An open-source, automated, and configurable pipeline for processing and analyzing large-scale neuroimaging datasets, built to facilitate reproducible research in connectomics.

openScienceProjects.name: Brainhack
openScienceProjects.description: Co-founder of Brainhack, an open science organization that organizes hackathons to facilitate interdisciplinary collaborative approaches to neuroscience; over 150 events held since 2012.

openScienceProjects.name: Preprocessed Connectomes Project (PCP)
openScienceProjects.description: Founded the Preprocessed Connectomes Project to enable sharing of preprocessed neuroimaging data and accelerate reproducible analyses across the community.

openScienceProjects.name: Organization for Human Brain Mapping — Open Science SIG (Founding Chair)
openScienceProjects.description: Founding Chair of the OHBM Open Science Special Interest Group (2016), helping establish community standards and resources for open neuroimaging.

openScienceProjects.name: Organization for Human Brain Mapping — Education Chair
openScienceProjects.description: Served as Education Chair for OHBM (2017–2019), organizing training, workshops, and community education initiatives.

grantsAwardsAndPublications.publications: Author on over 98 peer-reviewed scientific publications and a patent (h-index: 58, i10-index: 98).
grantsAwardsAndPublications.invitedSpeaker: Invited speaker at over 35 conferences, workshops, and symposia including SXSW (2016 & 2017).
